root.label: Hui Ka Yan sentenced to life in prison

events.label: Hui Ka Yan sentenced to life in prison

slots.name: life sentence
slots.sentence: The founder of China's Evergrande group, a liquidated property developer, was sentenced to life in prison on Thursday by a Chinese court, which ordered all his personal property confiscated.

slots.name: default liabilities
slots.sentence: Evergrande defaulted in 2021 on most of its $300 billion (roughly EUR255 billion) in liabilities and billions of dollars in wealth management product payments.

slots.name: Evergrande fine
slots.sentence: In addition to Hui's sentence, the court fined Evergrande 8.82 billion yuan ($1.31 billion; €1.12 billion) and its main subsidiary, Hengda Real Estate, 7 billion yuan, and imposed fines and prison terms of six to 18 years on five other senior executives.

slots.name: Hengda fine
slots.sentence: its main subsidiary, Hengda Real Estate, 7 billion yuan

slots.name: revenue inflation
slots.sentence: Investigators in Hong Kong and mainland China found Evergrande inflated its revenue by roughly $80 billion in 2019 and 2020, including by booking property sales before completion and delivery.

slots.name: executive prison terms
slots.sentence: imposed fines and prison terms of six to 18 years on five other senior executives.

slots.name: former companies fines
slots.sentence: Hui's former companies fined a total of $2.3 billion
